title: Care for the Mind amid Chronic Diseases: An Interpretable AI Approach Using IoT
authors: Jiaheng Xie; Xiaohang Zhao; Xiang Liu; Xiao Fang
main_or_robustness: not applicable (predictive deep-learning model, no causal panel design)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: main results tables (F1/precision/recall of depression detection)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: interpretable deep-learning classifier (TempPNet) predicting depression from wearable gait data; no regression, no treatment, no DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. The paper builds an interpretable deep-learning model that detects depression from accelerometer walking segments (NHANES, mPower) and evaluates predictive accuracy. There is no treatment variable or panel regression; the regression inventory is empty.
design_notes: Design science / predictive ML paper. Python/PyTorch code (main.py, train.py, models/). Results are classification metrics.
data_files_note: README states the data folder holds only a synthetic dataset: a small random draw of NHANES walking segments with Gaussian noise added; no demographics.
data_provenance_note: Authors' synthetic (noised) extract of NHANES; mPower is controlled access via Synapse.
screener_notes: Published text in data/text confirms a predictive AI design. Package matches the paper (depression detection from wearable sensor data). Not a near miss.
